description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas... Nueces River At Cotulla affecting La Salle County. Major flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Major flooding is forecast. * WHERE...Nueces River near Three Rivers. * WHEN...From Wednesday afternoon until further notice. * IMPACTS...At 40.0 feet, Significant flooding reaches miles from the main channel, flooding homes in the flood plain near Three Rivers to Lake Corpus Christi.
